subject: Data Engineering
title: Google BigQuery
description: A short lesson to help you apply Google BigQuery.

hook.text: BigQuery scans a petabyte in under 30 seconds. No index tuning. No cluster sizing. Just SQL.

buildup.text: BigQuery is Google's serverless data warehouse. There are no clusters to manage — just tables and queries.

discovery.text: It uses Dremel's columnar execution engine and Google's internal Colossus storage for massive parallel scans.

twist.text: Pricing is per query by bytes scanned. A single careless SELECT * on a large table can cost hundreds.

climax.text: BigQuery excels for ad-hoc analytics at scale — if your team governs query patterns and costs.

punchline.text: Petabyte queries in seconds. Just mind the bill.

quiz.question: How does BigQuery charge for queries?
options: By the amount of data scanned per query
By the number of rows returned
